hero.description: I'm Kehinde David Aderibigbe, a screenwriter with a passion for crafting compelling stories, memorable characters, and cinematic experiences that stay with you.

about.headline: The Story Behind the Writer
about.bioText: I'm Kehinde David Aderibigbe — a screenwriter driven by a deep love for storytelling. I write stories that explore real emotions, complex characters and powerful themes. Whether it's a drama, thriller, or an inspiring tale, I'm always focused on creating stories that connect, entertain, and make an impact.
about.modalParagraph1: Kehinde David Aderibigbe is an accomplished screenwriter and visual storyteller dedicated to developing character-driven cinematic narratives that provoke thought, evoke empathy, and linger long after the final credits roll.
about.modalParagraph2: Bridging contemporary global viewpoints with classic theatrical pacing, his writing focuses on rich interpersonal tensions, authentic dialogue, high-stakes moral dilemmas, and atmospheric worldbuilding.

selectedWork.headline: Some of My Scripts
selectedWork.subtitle: A look at a few of the projects I've developed and written.

featuredScripts.title: The Last Horizon
featuredScripts.logline: In a rain-drenched coastal town on the brink of economic collapse, a quiet harbourmaster confronts his estrangement from his daughter while sheltering a fugitive who holds the deed to the city’s last heritage dock.

featuredScripts.title: Echoes of Tomorrow
featuredScripts.logline: A forensic audio analyst reconstructing the final voicemails of a missing investigative reporter uncovers an algorithmic syndicate orchestrating high-frequency political assassinations.

featuredScripts.title: The Next Chapter
featuredScripts.logline: Following the sudden death of their family patriarch, three estranged adult siblings return to their ancestral vineyard to divide the estate, only to discover their father led an entirely clandestine double life.

featuredScripts.title: Beyond the Gate
featuredScripts.logline: When a atmospheric barrier sealing off a quarantined megacity sector begins to fail, an unaligned courier must escort an orphaned bio-engineer through forbidden zones to activate the failsafe generator.

catalogScripts.title: Echoes of the Caldera
catalogScripts.logline: When an isolated vulcanologist discovers anomalous harmonic seismic signals beneath an ancient dormant crater, he uncovers a suppressed corporate experiment tied to his late sister’s disappearance.

catalogScripts.title: The Silent Frequency
catalogScripts.logline: In a near-future metropolis where verbal speech is monitored by predictive audio sensors, a rogue telegraphist and an ex-sound engineer transmit encrypted counter-narratives over forgotten analog frequencies.

catalogScripts.title: Harvest of Solitude
catalogScripts.logline: A young botanical archivist in coastal West Africa fights to preserve ancestral agricultural remedies while navigating familial friction and high-stakes pharmaceutical patent battles.
